title: Freya and the Colony
author: Yara Fairweather
blurb: Beatrix Almeida, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
